verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents npm as a package manager and registry: installing, publishing, searching, and configuring packages. It never mentions defining automations, nor versioning, reviewing, or rolling them back. Package versioning (e.g., installing the latest version of a package) and lock files cover a different capability and do not count toward versioning or rolling back user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
